question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence "***Motives also help in making (3)________ about behaviour".***The word **predictions **fit the best in the context of the passage.
 
• **Predictions **mean saying what will happen; what somebody thinks will happen (भविष्यवाणी).
 
 
• **Example**- The exam results confirmed my predictions.
